name: Метки
handoff: Create a UTF-8 JSON template with string field values. The user opens it via Действия → Открыть файл, reviews it, then presses Записать on Android Chrome with NFC. The browser requires the user's gesture and NFC permission. There is no remote tag-writing API.
reportPrivacy: Report exports omit record payloads, tag serial and record IDs by default. The user may explicitly include them. Imported reports are labelled as files and never presented as a new physical scan. Hardware declarations in report files are ignored.
locationFormat: HTTPS Google Maps link for Android and iPhone background URL opening; legacy raw geo records are preserved
privacy: Tag data and imported templates stay on the user's device. Do not include credentials in example templates or URLs.
